we propose ViLBERT, a task agnostic joint representation for vision and language tasks, which we train through pretraining on a large corpus.
we present ViLBERT, an exten sion of the BERT model for learning joint representations of image and text.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a model trained on a proxy task can generalize to multiple downstream tasks.
the task agnostic pretraining of joint representations of images and language can be an effective approach for improving performance across multiple vision and language tasks.
joint visual and textual representations can be learned through pretraining on a proxy task and then transferred to a variety of downstream tasks without the need for any task specific modifications.
